##### Project general facts

Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 5 & 6 is a refined residential community offering a selection of single- and two-storey townhouses alongside luxurious 4- to 7-bedroom villas. Designed with a timeless and nostalgic architectural character, the residences blend harmoniously with their landscaped surroundings while providing spacious interiors and elegant living spaces. The community combines traditional charm with modern comfort, creating a sophisticated and family-oriented environment.

The development is surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens and peaceful green spaces, creating a serene setting for residents to relax and enjoy outdoor living. Thoughtfully designed surroundings encourage families to spend time outdoors while maintaining a sense of privacy and tranquillity. The community provides a welcoming environment where comfort, nature, and refined living come together.

The townhouses feature high ceilings, abundant natural light, airy open second floors, and expanded balcony areas overlooking lush gardens. The villas offer open-plan layouts with spacious living areas beneath double-height ceilings, ensuite bathrooms in all bedrooms, and generous second-floor balconies with garden and street views. Bedrooms are designed as peaceful retreats with warm timber-effect tiles and light grey walls, complemented by high-quality finishes throughout. The kitchens are equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba is located south of Dubai Creek, near the part of the city where indigenous people traditionally settle. Nad Al Sheba is close to Al Quoz, Silicon Dubai Oasis, Ras Al Khor industrial area and Al Markada. Properties here include villas, apartments and serviced apartments. A rich legacy awaits in a setting that resonates with all those who know the area. 

The serene greenery of Nad Al Sheba is one of the city’s most covetable locations. A mere ten minutes from Downtown Dubai, this luxurious community has easy access to the Meydan Racetrack and many other premium leisure and lifestyle experiences. The Dubai International Airport and all major highways also lie within arm’s reach of Nad Al Sheba’s enviable location.  

Nad Al Sheba Gardens is strategically located to give you the utmost in a privacy-focused lifestyle while connecting you to the best of Dubai’s city life. It’s a space built around carefully curated amenities. All this and more makes Nad Al Sheba Gardens a community tailored to truly nurture your inner and outer growth for today and future generations to come.
